text:
8.7 Hook functions
Hook functions are called by the operating system if specific conditions are met. They
are provided by the user. Besides the ProtectionHook below, the hooks from [10] and/
or extensions from 7.12 may be called by the OS.
caption: 8.7 Hook functions
